title: Get started
goal: A first drive: arm it, send it somewhere, stop it and bring it home.

steps.text: Press and hold Arm in the Cockpit tab.
steps.hint: Armed, it answers commands. Disarmed, it stays where it is.

steps.text: Press Go to in the Cockpit tab, then click a place on the map.
steps.hint: Go to drives it to the place you clicked and stops it there.

steps.text: Choose HOLD in the Mode menu in the Cockpit tab.
steps.hint: HOLD stops it where it is.

steps.text: Press Return to launch in the Cockpit tab.
steps.hint: Return to launch drives it back to where it started.

steps.text: Wait for it to get home.
steps.hint: Watch it on the map: it stops in the Home ring.
